name: DSSSB
intro: DSSSB applications need a passport-size photograph and a signature in fixed physical sizes and KB ranges.

notes: 3.5 × 4.5 cm, JPG, 25–100 KB, recent and in colour.
Bright, light background, preferably white, with your face clearly visible.
documents.label: Photograph

notes: Sign yourself on white paper with a black pen.
documents.label: Signature

faqs.q: What is the DSSSB photo size?
faqs.a: 3.5 × 4.5 cm, JPG, between 25 KB and 100 KB.

faqs.q: What is the DSSSB signature size?
faqs.a: 3.5 × 1.5 cm, JPG, between 10 KB and 50 KB.
